stages.name: licence_gate
stages.note: Refused papers carry no Creative Commons licence in the publisher's permissions block (LicenseTier.unknown). This is the Phase 1 compliance rule working as designed, not a failure.

stages.name: select
stages.note: kept 17 of 24 by concept overlap with the question (acidosis, acidosis, lactic, metformin), where a cluster side counts as overlapping if it IS a query concept or belongs to a pharmacological class the query named (ADR-0022, member->class only); ordered by relevance to the query (ADR-0020: matched sides, then MeSH hierarchy proximity, then key order; size is deliberately not a signal).

stages.name: critic
stages.note: Contradiction detection is not implemented. The CTD-derived gold standard was retired by Gate 2 (pi-hat = 0.067) and the re-scoped alternative was declined; see ADR-0017.

stages.name: synthesis
stages.note: Deterministic template (ADR-0019). Citation assembly is not yet built.
